problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:

* Package Alpha: size 52 cubic feet
* Package Beta: size 39 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: size 67 cubic feet
* Package Delta: size 39 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: size 66 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: size 57 cubic feet
* Package Eta: size 46 cubic feet
* Package Theta: size 43 cubic feet
* Package Iota: size 37 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: size 40 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: size 38 cubic feet
* Package Mu: size 58 cubic feet
* Package Nu: size 64 cubic feet
* Package Xi: size 57 cubic feet
* Package Omicron: size 41 cubic feet
* Package Pi: size 32 cubic feet
* Package Rho: size 49 cubic feet
* Package Sigma: size 60 cubic feet
* Package Tau: size 66 cubic feet
* Package Upsilon: size 35 cubic feet
* Package Phi: size 53 cubic feet
* Package Chi: size 36 cubic feet
* Package Psi: size 36 cubic feet
* Package Omega: size 61 cubic feet
* Package A1: size 45 cubic feet
* Package B1: size 63 cubic feet
* Package C1: size 32 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot surpass its capacity limit.
